title: Operational and Randomized Check Values
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game with label set $\text{Fin}(q)$, let $T$ be a long-code table, let $v$ be a vertex, and let $C$ be a sign-query check. The check's expected acceptance when each query position independently chooses a uniformly random neighbor of $v$ and returns that neighbor's permuted table response equals the check's randomized value on the function obtained by averaging those permuted responses over the neighbors of $v$.
